'''Docking Bay 28''', also known as '''Hangar 28''', was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in the [[Anchorhead Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="On the Run" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> the [[Raal's Regulators]] were hunting [[Jemala Ha'rangir]], a [[Hidden Chain]] [[Desertion/Legends|defector]], and docked their ship, the ''[[Mercenary's Honor]]'', at the docking bay. Later, the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Akaavi Spar]] entered the docking bay to stop the Regulators and defeated them.<ref name="On the Run" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay 28 first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

If the player is affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the ship will be docked at [[Docking Bay 73 (Tatooine)|Docking Bay 73]] in the [[Mos Ila Spaceport]] instead.<ref name="On the Run" />
